title: How Do Radars See Planes in the Dark? ✈️
description: Discover how radar detects planes, clouds, and cars from miles away. Learn how sending and bouncing waves works in under a minute.

scenes.say: How does radar spot planes and cars in total darkness and heavy fog from miles away?

scenes.caption: Sending radio pulses
scenes.say: The device shoots out short pulses of radio waves in every direction through space.
When these waves smash into a solid object like a plane, they bounce right back as an echo.

scenes.label: Speed of light and waves
scenes.say: These waves travel at the speed of light, which is one hundred eighty-six thousand miles per second.
Radar calculates the exact distance by measuring how long the wave took to return.
This method is just like how bats find their prey by bouncing sounds off objects.
